info.name: YMONEY API
info.description: Generated from the live spec (`GET /openapi.json`) — regenerate with `python scripts/gen_postman.py`. Set collection variables first: baseUrl, workspaceId, jwt (login), apiKey (mint via api-keys).

request.description:
Activity Stream

Server-Sent Events stream of live workspace activity.

EventSource cannot send Authorization headers, so the bearer token may be
supplied as ?token= as an alternative to the header. Header auth still
takes precedence when present.

Agent Detail

Per-agent detail: catalog info + config + run history + aggregates.

item.name: List registered agent skills and tools

request.description: List registered agent skills and tools

item.name: Performance breakdowns by topic, hook style, and duration

request.description:
Performance breakdowns by topic, hook style, and duration

Group measured posts by observable content features (topic, hook style,
duration bucket). Mock and real posts are counted separately — never mixed.

item.name: Mint a scoped API key (plaintext shown once)

request.description: Mint a scoped API key (plaintext shown once)

Add a workspace template (credited authorship)

Community pattern: workspaces author their own templates with attribution
(+ optional source link) instead of only patching built-ins. Collisions
with built-in ids are rejected — customize those via override patches.

item.name: Cut a long-form source into vertical shorts

request.description:
Cut a long-form source into vertical shorts

Synchronous cutting of an operator-supplied source into workspace assets.

Download requires yt-dlp; cutting requires ffmpeg. When unavailable the
endpoint reports the exact remediation instead of failing obscurely.

item.name: Download one stock clip by Pexels id

request.description: Download one stock clip by Pexels id

Generate scene images

Generate images via the configured provider and store them as workspace
assets. Mock provider results are labeled is_mock=true.

List Assets

All video artifacts this workspace has produced, plus uploaded files.

Real data only: rows come from the videos/variants tables plus the
workspace uploads directory (operator-supplied files).

List creation templates (versioned registry)

Built-in caption/hook/motion templates, latest version each.

Workspaces override any template via PUT /workspaces/{id}/settings with
{"settings": {"templates": {"<module>/<id>": {payload patch, ...}}}} —
overrides merge over the built-in and are flagged "overridden".

item.name: Per-scene visual plan for a topic

request.description: Per-scene visual plan for a topic

Pre-flight source quality check (never blocks)

Fast yt-dlp/local probe before burning a cycle (openshorts quality_probe
pattern). Always 200 — unknown sources degrade to probe="unknown" with a
warning instead of failing.

item.name: Preview any voice-stack provider with extras

request.description:
Preview any voice-stack provider with extras

Narrate a sample through a chosen provider (clone/emotion aware).

Uses the workspace default provider when blank. Returns raw audio bytes
with provider headers — the manual surface of the Voice Designer.

item.name: Register a typed media asset reference

request.description: Register a typed media asset reference

Render a kinetic motion-graphics card

Render a hook/stat/CTA/lower-third card via HyperFrames.

Requires the HyperFrames CLI + a working Chrome + ffmpeg; otherwise fails
closed with remediation (503) instead of faking output.

Render a talking-head presenter clip

Photo + (audio | voiced text) → lip-synced MP4 via the avatar stack.

Requires image + exactly one of audio/text; fails closed with remediation
when no backend is ready.

Serve a registered media file

Workspace-guarded file serve for editor preview/proxy use.

The storage_key is resolved strictly inside the workspace directory;
absolute keys and escapes were already rejected at registration, and are
re-checked here (defense in depth for legacy rows).

item.name: Translate and re-voice a video into another language

request.description:
Translate and re-voice a video into another language

Synchronous dub: transcribe/parse → LLM translate → TTS → assemble.

Requires LLM key + target-language TTS voice + ffmpeg; otherwise fails
closed with remediation (400/503).

Upload an MP4/image asset

Operator-supplied asset stored under the workspace boundary.

item.name: Validate a dub request (no downloads, no AI calls)

request.description:
Validate a dub request (no downloads, no AI calls)

OpenCreator `--dry-run` pattern: command-shape + capability matrix only.
Always 200 — failures come back as check rows, never exceptions.

item.name: Auto-fill the calendar at best hours within caps

request.description:
Auto-fill the calendar at best hours within caps

Run the Scheduler planner: APPROVED + render-ready content fills the
coming days at best measured hours. Idempotent — re-running changes nothing.

item.name: Best publish hours from measured history

request.description:
Best publish hours from measured history

Hour-of-day (workspace timezone-naive UTC) ranked by average views.

Falls back to generic evening hours when fewer than 3 measured posts exist.

Images Test

Generate one small test image; returns raw image bytes.

Test Llm

Live reachability + auth check of the effective LLM configuration.

Test Publishing

Live validation of the real publishing paths.

Checks: (1) Upload-Post relay credentials — validated against the provider's
/api/uploadposts/me endpoint; (2) connected platform accounts with tokens.
Never raises: every failure is reported as structured status.

Tts Status

Effective TTS provider, health, and available voices.

Tts Test

Synthesize a short narration sample; returns raw audio bytes.

Video Engine Status

Effective engine config, live health, version, capabilities.

request.description: Chronological event history for this item

item.name: Estimate render cost for a would-be video

request.description:
Estimate render cost for a would-be video

Engine-aware flat estimate (MPT exposes no monetary cost, so the
estimate is the configured per-render value times video_count). Safe on
any engine: unreachable engines still return the configuration estimate.

Evidence bundle: WHAT/WHY/render/publish trail

One-click transparency export: strategy decision, research claims,
variants, QC checks, compliance findings, publishing jobs and posts.

item.name: Parent/child lineage for a content item

request.description: Parent/child lineage for a content item

item.name: Repurpose a long-form URL into short-form clip drafts

request.description:
Repurpose a long-form URL into short-form clip drafts

Download + cut a source video into short segments, each becoming a
ContentItem draft in the library. Returns the list of created items.

Falls back to honest error responses when yt-dlp/ffmpeg are unavailable
rather than silently producing nothing.

Switch selected variant (pre-render only)

Manually pick a different script variant for hook A/B decisions.

Allowed only in SCRIPT_READY with no rendered video yet — switching after
a render would orphan the artifact (use retry/regenerate instead).

Cost Intelligence

Per-cycle / per-video / per-platform / per-agent / efficiency economics.

item.name: Full cycle execution detail: stage jobs + agent runs with step traces

request.description: Full cycle execution detail: stage jobs + agent runs with step traces

Next Best Action Preview

Live NEXT BEST ACTION with the complete WHY breakdown.

item.name: Agent pipeline as a live DAG with per-node stats

request.description:
Agent pipeline as a live DAG with per-node stats

Returns the agent pipeline in execution order with live state.

The frontend renders this as a horizontal DAG; each node shows live status
(busy/idle/disabled/error), run counts, failure rate and average duration.

item.name: Per-minute metric buckets for the last 60 minutes

request.description:
Per-minute metric buckets for the last 60 minutes

Bucket agent runs, failures, events and cost into 1-minute slots.

Empty buckets are returned as zeros so the chart can render a continuous
axis (60 points) without client-side gap-filling.

item.name: One repair pass for missing media

request.description:
Rebuild timeline (manual-edit protected)

Rebuild the timeline from pipeline artifacts. When the timeline was
manually edited after generation (version advanced), requires explicit
confirm=true so human work is never silently destroyed.

item.name: Manually select an opportunity for production

request.description: Manually select an opportunity for production

Public Media

Serve one workspace video/image file behind a short-lived signed token.

Used to build publicly reachable video_url links for PULL-style platform
APIs (Instagram Graph) without requiring S3/CDN.

Oauth Youtube Callback

Browser-facing callback. Returns a tiny HTML page that closes the popup.

Dangling media/publish rows (counts only)

Scheduled-sweep support: counts of videos/variants/jobs/posts whose
parent row is gone (no FK cascade audit in the schema). Counts only —
no content, safe to poll. Fail-closed: errors yield zeros + detail.

One-call Doctor: readiness + health + remediation

Aggregated Doctor parity check: every probe with latency + remediation.

Fail-closed: never throws, always 200 with per-probe ok/detail/remediation.
Powers SystemHealth UI + Setup checklist + future `npm run doctor` equivalent.

System Mode

Deployment mode + mock flags (powers the frontend REAL/MOCK badge).

System Readiness

Real production readiness: probes LLM auth, video engine, ffmpeg,
storage, trends and publishing configuration. No fake providers.
